questions.question_english:
57. High levels of public debt can lead to a situation
where government borrowing absorbs domestic
financial savings, resulting in increased interest rates and
reduced investment in the private sector. What is this
situation referred to as?
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is the 'Crowding-out Effect'. This phenomenon occurs when government borrowing leads to higher interest rates, which in turn discourages private sector investment. As the government borrows more, it competes for available financial resources, causing interest rates to rise. This makes it more expensive for businesses to borrow money for investment, leading to a decrease in private sector investment.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। 'भीड़-से बाहर प्रभाव' उस घटना को संदर्भित करता है जब सरकारी उधारी के कारण ब्याज दरें बढ़ जाती हैं, जिससे निजी क्षेत्र के निवेश में कमी आती है। जब सरकार अधिक उधार लेती है, तो यह उपलब्ध वित्तीय संसाधनों के लिए प्रतिस्पर्धा करती है, जिससे ब्याज दरें बढ़ जाती हैं। यह व्यवसायों के लिए निवेश के लिए पैसे उधार लेना महंगा बना देता है, जिससे निजी क्षेत्र के निवेश में कमी आती है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) भीड़-से बाहर प्रभाव
Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: The phenomenon occurs when government borrowing leads to higher interest rates, discouraging private investment.

65. Evaluate the following statements regarding the
Mental Healthcare Act, 2017:
A. It decriminalizes suicide attempts by
presuming that a person attempting suicide
is under severe stress.
B. It grants every individual the right to make
an ‘Advance Directive’ concerning their
preferred treatment for mental illness.
C. It prohibits the use of Electroconvulsive Therapy
(ECT) without muscle relaxants and

However, statement D is incorrect as the Act does not mandate immediate incarceration of individuals diagnosed with severe mental illness.

questions.question_english:
50. Match List I with List II:
List I: (Constitutional Article)
P. Article 330
Q. Article 332
R. Article 338
S. Article 338A
List II: (Provision for SCs and STs)
I. Reservation of seats for SCs and STs in the
House of the People (Lok Sabha)
II. Reservation of seats for SCs and STs in
State Legislative Assemblies
III. National Commission for Scheduled Castes
IV. National Commission for Scheduled Tribes
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is A. Article 330 provides for the reservation of seats for Scheduled Castes (SCs) and Scheduled Tribes (STs) in the Lok Sabha, which corresponds to provision I. Article 332 pertains to the reservation of seats for SCs and STs in State Legislative Assemblies, corresponding to provision II. Article 338 establishes the National Commission for Scheduled Castes, corresponding to provision III, and Article 338A establishes the National Commission for Scheduled Tribes, corresponding to provision IV. Therefore, the correct matching is P-I, Q-II, R-III, S-IV.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। अनुच्छेद 330 लोक सभा में अनुसूचित जातियों (SCs) और अनुसूचित जनजातियों (STs) के लिए सीटों के आरक्षण की व्यवस्था करता है, जो प्रावधान I के अनुरूप है। अनुच्छेद 332 राज्य विधानसभाओं में SCs और STs के लिए सीटों के आरक्षण से संबंधित है, जो प्रावधान II के अनुरूप है। अनुच्छेद 338 अनुसूचित जातियों के लिए राष्ट्रीय आयोग की स्थापना करता है, जो प्रावधान III के अनुरूप है, और अनुच्छेद 338A अनुसूचित जनजातियों के लिए राष्ट्रीय आयोग की स्थापना करता है, जो प्रावधान IV के अनुरूप है। इसलिए, सही मिलान P-I, Q-II, R-III, S-IV है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) P-I, Q-II, R-III, S-IV

questions.question_english: 85. What is the primary challenge posed by 'Automation' in the manufacturing and service sectors for developing nations like India?
questions.explanation_english: The primary challenge of automation in developing economies like India is the displacement of routine and semi-skilled labor before structural economic transition creates sufficient high-skilled replacement jobs. Rapid adoption of industrial robotics and software automation reduces demand for entry-level manual roles, creating employment absorption pressures for young job seekers who lack advanced technical skills required by modern automated industries.
